selection.distance: breadth-first hops on undirected source edges with transit barriers
selection.fanout: distinct full-source consumers; protected MM routes may pass
selection.effect_policy: Call-only mutable schema, FX-impure, nondeterministic tag, or explicit compiler RNG/state schema
selection.effects: Exclude effect calls before traversal; protection cannot cross them; results may become boundary inputs
selection.outputs: Keep escaping values with an internal matmul ancestor; DCE from those outputs only
selection.shape_interface: Coalesce typed shape values equal across every own config; preserve logical structure and settings

digest_policy: SHA-256 of ID-ordered graph data; node IDs are not canonical labels
exact_matcher: Exact joint incidence color refinement, then VF2 on original directed graphs; verify original colors and ports

matmul_limit.settings_policy: Preserve every own input configuration of each eligible structure

metric.name: directed_wl_multiset_jaccard_v1
metric.refinement: All nodes; full node colors and separate directed incoming/outgoing full argument-port bundles
metric.boundary: Input roles and containers participate in refinement; boundary nodes are not feature centers
metric.settings: Concrete input shape, stride, dtype, device, generators and aliases are excluded
metric.interpretation: Local structural feature overlap, not common FX node percentage, global isomorphism or semantic equivalence

sampling.representative_order: Descending compute-call count, descending matmul count, ascending full structure SHA-256
sampling.settings_policy: Keep every own config of retained structures; discarded nonidentical structures and their settings are not transplanted
